summary: Transcript tool rows preserve read, search, run, change, subagent, web, decision and todo kinds with scoped targets. Runs show their readable command's first nonempty line before cwd; cwd-only targets use their last two path segments. Orphan results have an unknown kind and an Invocation not loaded title, without inferred targets. Successful output no longer opens automatically; each row has one inline raw input/output disclosure and retains its inspector entry. Human titles are plain text, not shell syntax.

compatibility.detail: No wire change. WorkKind uses change instead of edit and adds search, subagent, web, decision, todo and unknown (unobserved invocation). WorkLogV1 removes automatic previewCallDetail; output is opened deliberately through the row.
